$comment: Single source of truth for every third-party artefact the build, the validator and the conformance run download. Every entry is pinned by exact version and by SHA-256 (http) or commit SHA (git). Facts about 'latest' were read from each project's own repository on 2026-10-30. Edit pins only together with a re-run of `npm run conformance`.

kosit-xrechnung-config.note: Official KoSIT bundle: CEN EN 16931 XSLT (CII, UBL), XRechnung CIUS XSLT (CII, UBL), UBL 2.1 and CII D16B XSD, scenarios.xml.

kosit-validator.note: Official KoSIT validator. Needs Java 11+. Only used by the optional conformance cross-check.

cen-en16931.licence: EUPL-1.2 (not redistributed; fetched at build time)

peppol-bis-3.licence: see repository (not redistributed; fetched at build time)

schxslt2.note: Schematron-to-XSLT compiler. Pinned from Maven Central, whose published .sha256 matches the pin. The original pin pointed at Codeberg, which is unreachable from some networks.

factur-x-wheel.note: Supplies the French CTC Schematron and the Factur-X/ZUGFeRD XSDs. 7.x renamed the Schematron files; the scripts are written for 6.8.

xrechnung-testsuite.licence: Apache-2.0 (per repository LICENSE); fetched, not committed

saxonjs-runtime.note: Browser runtime (SaxonJS2.rt.js). Free to bundle, not to redistribute standalone, so it is fetched, never committed. Override with CONFORMO_SAXONJS_ZIP=<local zip> on networks that block downloads.saxonica.com.

ksef-docs.licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Ministerstwo Finansow (CIRFMF is the Ministry of Finance's IT centre); not redistributed, fetched at build time
ksef-docs.note: Official KSeF documentation repository; faktury/schemy/FA/schemat_FA(3)_v1-0E.xsd is the FA(3) schema.

mustang-cli.note: Mustangproject command-line tool (Apache-2.0). Only used by the informative comparison tools/compare-mustang.mjs, never by validate(). Maven Central publishes SHA-1 only; the SHA-1 it publishes (8755fc333032f802ad7dcf3930201edfe64014e2) matched the download pinned here.
